The five largest medical device and technology companies in the world by annual sales revenue are Medtronic, Johnson & Johnson (MedTech division), Abbott Laboratories, \[Medline Industries\], and Siemens Healthineers. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

- **Medtronic:** Global leader in cardiac and vascular devices, neurologic products, and surgical tools.

- **Johnson & Johnson MedTech:** Massive portfolio covering orthopedics, surgery, and vision care.

- **Abbott Laboratories:** Renowned for diabetes care (such as FreeStyle Libre) and cardiovascular diagnostics.

- **Medline Industries:** Major manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies and surgical equipment

- **Siemens Healthineers:** Specialized in diagnostic imaging, laboratory diagnostics, and advanced clinical IT. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

[Williams Medical Supplies](https://www.wms.co.uk/) does not primarily manufacture or distribute consumer smartwatches, wearable ECGs, dedicated sleep trackers, or direct-to-consumer remote patient monitoring systems. They focus on supplying primary and secondary care clinics with standard diagnostic equipment, pharmaceuticals, and medical consumables. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Williams_Medical_Supplies_plc)

- **Diagnostics:** Standard clinic equipment like stethoscopes, otoscopes, and traditional blood pressure monitors.

- **Diabetes & Testing:** Blood glucose meters, strips, and testing kits meant for clinical or point-of-care use rather than continuous consumer wearable ecosystems.

- **General Practice Gear:** Consumables, furniture, and medical refrigeration units for surgeries.

### Where to Find Wearable Health Tech

If you are looking for advanced remote monitoring or wearable tracking tech, consider these alternatives:

- **Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):** Look at dedicated medical brands like Abbott FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom.

- **Wearable ECG & Smartwatches:** Consumer and clinical-grade heart and sleep tracking are available through platforms like [Apple Watch](https://www.apple.com/watch) or Fitbit/Google.

- **Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):** Specialized IoT platforms like Vivalink provide medical-grade patches and remote tracking ecosystems for healthcare providers. [](https://www.vivalink.com/wearable-products)
